name: N7, Vilnius
projectType: Kindergarten + residential building under construction, Bendoriai (Vilnius district)
notes:
N7, Vilnius – kindergarten + residential building under construction at Bendorėlių 1-oji al. 4, Bendoriai (Avižieniai eldership, Vilnius district). Borrower UAB Enart (306352723), established 07.07.2023, director Mantas Bieliauskas. General contractor UAB Anselta (304915322). Building permit and technical design in place.

Preliminary terms (Tautvydas, 23 Oct 2026): loan EUR 2.5m, 11%, InRento fee 8%, one tranche. Term, drawdown date, purpose of funds and repayment structure not set yet.

Appraisal (UAB Jungtinis verslas, AB26/0430/07N, valuation date 30.04.2026, report 11.05.2026): market value as-is EUR 3,150,000 excl. VAT (residual method; building ~50% complete). Split: land plot share 4400-5247-5553 EUR 469,000; corridor plot share 4400-5246-6554 EUR 4,200; building 4400-6685-1847 EUR 2,676,800. Appraiser's gross development value EUR 6,475,000 incl. VAT (apartments 1,495.94 m² at EUR 2,647/m², kindergarten 1,428.32 m² at EUR 1,599/m², 30 parking spaces at EUR 7,700).

Business plan (Aug/Oct 2026): project cost EUR 4,504,418 incl. VAT (EUR 3,722,660 excl.); construction budget EUR 3,847,618 incl. VAT, of which EUR 1,322,225 done and EUR 2,525,393 remaining. Plan: sell 1,350 m² of apartments at EUR 2,800/m² incl. VAT and 30 parking spaces at EUR 6,500 (EUR 3,975,000 incl. VAT / EUR 3,285,124 excl.); keep 1,527 m² (1,427 m² public-use + 100 m² residential) for long-term rent at EUR 18.00/m²/month excl. VAT (EUR 329,832 a year, +3% p.a.). Stages: II Jan–Aug 2026 (facades, roofs), III Aug 2026–Apr 2027 (interior, finishing, engineering). BP states EUR 2.3m already invested as related-company loans; BP was written for a bank loan of EUR 1.5–2.0m.

Balance sheet 31.07.2026 (preliminary, unapproved): total assets EUR 1.86m (land 780k, WIP 955k, cash 35k); equity −EUR 187k; long-term borrowings EUR 500k + other long-term payables EUR 1.30m; trade payables EUR 211k.
